definitions.explanation: A year containing 366 days, with an extra day added at the end of February. Occurs roughly every four years.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{閏年|うるうどし}だ。
examples.english: This year is a leap year.

examples.japanese: {閏年|うるうどし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{二月|にがつ}→二月：00657_nigatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{二十九日|にじゅうくにち}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In a leap year, February has up to the 29th.

examples.japanese: {閏年|うるうどし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生|う}まれた→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{誕生日|たんじょうび}→誕生日：02910_tanjoubi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祝|いわ}う→祝う：01881_iwau⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迷|まよ}う→迷う：02426_mayou⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧そうだ。
examples.english: People born in a leap year sometimes have trouble deciding which day to celebrate their birthday on.

notes:
Composed of {閏|うるう} (intercalary; extra) + ⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧ (year). The day added in a leap year is {閏日|うるうび} (Feb 29).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {閏年|うるうどし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧: to fall on a leap year
- {閏日|うるうび}: leap day (Feb 29)
- {閏年|うるうどし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧: a non-leap year (⟦{平年|へいねん}→平年：24128_heinen⟧)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{平年|へいねん}→平年：24128_heinen⟧: ordinary (non-leap) year
- {閏秒|うるうびょう}: leap second
- {閏月|うるうづき}: intercalary month (in the old lunar calendar)
